{"type": "object", "description": "A tool result in scope (every result, or only toolName's) whose content matches EVERY pattern (all within one result) occurred at least min (default 1) and at most max times. min and max count MATCHING results, not all results: min 0, max 0 means no result matches. The content is the result's text, then structuredContent, then its JSON output part (JSON as canonical JSON), or, with path, the value at that key in structuredContent (in the JSON output part when there is no structuredContent). isError results are included. A result whose text was truncated for storage (when path is omitted), or whose subject exceeds 100000 characters, is unreadable; so are results an incomplete capture did not record.
